blocks.title: Aggregate and merge
blocks.code:
totals = (
    orders.groupby("customer_id", as_index=False)
          .agg(order_count=("order_id", "nunique"),
               revenue=("amount", "sum"))
)
result = customers.merge(totals, on="customer_id", how="left")
